REQ-1.description: The release source (manifest.json, payload/, fixtures/, templates/) is staged apart from this repository's own installation, and built into a deterministic package (workflow-V.tar.gz, workflow-V.manifest.json, SHA256SUMS), deflated by a pinned, hash-checked compression runtime, that reproduces every published release (2.3.1 to 2.6.0) byte-for-byte from its tag, in CI's own runtime.

REQ-2.description: Pull-request titles are Conventional Commits, checked by one stdlib implementation, and a title's release impact agrees with the release-source version change the pull request makes.

REQ-3.description: CI on every pull request and main push checks the release source and this repository's installation: the release source's own conformance suites run in a conformance fixture, its package builds and passes the Workflow Manager's package verify and bootstrap/verify, a published version's release source is unchanged (immutability), and workflow-manager verify . passes on the checkout. A single 'aggregate' job is the required check.

REQ-4.description: A release workflow publishes vV with its three assets, in one immutable release, exactly when a green main push carries a manifest version V that has no published release; otherwise it publishes nothing. A draft or a tag left by a failed publication is not a publication: the workflow refuses on it and a documented, tested recovery makes V publishable again. A published release whose read-back fails is never reported as nothing to release on a later run: every run reads an already-published V back and fails, and a documented, tested supersession publishes the next patch version instead. Never moves a published tag or replaces an asset.

REQ-5.description: main protection (squash-only merge, Conventional-Commit squash titles, required checks, no bypass) is recorded as reviewed data and applied by the repository owner, never by CI or an agent.

REQ-6.description: docs/RELEASING.md and README.md document the release model, the two copies of the Workflow, the workflow-manager pin follow-up, and this milestone's cutover.
